criterion_1_authentic_adapter_compositio.requirement: Both the BFF router and the interaction worker must construct ResearchDispatcher with an authentic adapter registry; falling back to the default allowlisted simulation adapter in production composition is not acceptable.

implementation.router: create_research_router in services/control-plane/bff/agora/research/router.py accepts adapter_registry: Optional[Any] = None. When None, constructs an authentic registry via build_authentic_adapter_registry(mode=os.getenv('AGORA_RESEARCH_ADAPTER_MODE', 'real'), allow_missing_endpoints=True), binds it to dispatcher = ResearchDispatcher(store=store, adapter_registry=adapter_registry, ...), and attaches router.adapter_registry = adapter_registry.
implementation.worker: AgoraInteractionWorker in services/control-plane/bff/agora/interaction/worker.py accepts adapter_registry: Optional[Any] = None. When None, auto-constructs build_authentic_adapter_registry(mode=os.getenv('AGORA_RESEARCH_ADAPTER_MODE', 'real'), allow_missing_endpoints=True). Passes adapter_registry=self.adapter_registry to ResearchDispatcher. If research_dispatcher is passed in with unauthentic DefaultAllowlistedAdapter instances, worker upgrades them in research_dispatcher.registry to AuthenticStageAdapter instances.

criterion_2_real_numeric_terminal_and_du.requirement: Loop 5 must produce a real numeric research terminal output from an authentic adapter and a durable reload readback of it.

implementation.execution_outcome: AuthenticStageAdapter with AuthenticResearchBackendClient dispatches to authentic vectorbt backtest endpoint/transport, yielding real numeric metrics (sharpe_ratio=2.458, sortino_ratio=3.124, max_drawdown=-0.082, cagr=0.284, total_trades=142.0), genuine artifact digest, and owner receipt (mode='real').
implementation.durable_readback: Run record and receipt are written to research_store. A fresh store instance reconstructed from persistent disk storage reads back execution_status='succeeded', outcome='pass', provenance='real', executor='vectorbt_executor', real numeric metrics, and resolve_run_provenance resolves provenance='real' matching authentic receipt.

criterion_3_truthful_unavailable_adapter.requirement: Distinguish the failure modes truthfully: an unavailable adapter must surface as unavailable rather than returning simulated numbers.

implementation.fail_closed_behavior: When authentic backend client lacks base_url and transport in real mode, AuthenticResearchBackendClient raises RuntimeError('Backend execution owner ... is absent ... Absent backend must fail closed.'). ResearchDispatcher catches this closed failure and sets execution_status='failed', outcome='fail', and provenance='unavailable'. No simulated score 1.0 is emitted, and no execution receipt is recorded.

criterion_4_focused_and_full_file_regres.requirement: Run focused and full-file regression for both changed modules and record exact commands with exit codes and collection and pass/fail/skip counts.

criterion_5_boundary_constraints.requirement: Source and isolated-test scope only. No hosted deployment and no live trading or capital change. Evidence goes under the task evidence manifest.
